title: Numbers to 120: Tens and Ones
seo_title: Grade 1 Numbers to 120: Tens and Ones Worksheets (TEKS 1.2B)
standard_text: 1.2B use concrete and pictorial models to compose and decompose numbers up to 120 in more than one way as so many hundreds, so many tens, and so many ones; 1.2C use objects, pictures, and expanded and standard forms to represent numbers up to 120
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 place value worksheets for Texas TEKS 1.2B and 1.2C: base-ten blocks, teen numbers, tens and ones and expanded form to 120. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A ten is 10 ones. 47 is 4 tens and 7 ones.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A ten is 10 ones put together. A rod shows 1 ten.
  • In 47, the 4 means 4 tens (40) and the 7 means 7 ones.
  • 47 = 40 + 7. This is the expanded form.
  • 12 ones is the same as 1 ten and 2 ones.

Examples

Example

3 rods and 6 cubes

3 tens = 30

30 + 6

Answer: 36

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Swapping tens and onesThe tens digit is on the left.
Counting a rod as 1Each rod is 10.
Writing 40 + 5 as 40540 + 5 = 45.

items.q: In which number does the 5 mean 5 tens?
items.e: The tens digit is the first digit. In 51 the 5 is first, so it means 5 tens. In the other numbers the 5 is in the ones place.

items.q: In which number does the 3 mean 3 tens?
items.e: The tens digit is the first digit. In 34 the 3 is first, so it means 3 tens. In the other numbers the 3 is in the ones place.

items.q: What number do the blocks show?
items.e: Count the rods: 10, 20. Count the cubes: 12. 10 cubes make 1 more ten. So it is 3 tens and 2 ones. That is 32.

items.q: What number do the blocks show?
items.e: Count the rods: 10. Count the cubes: 14. 10 cubes make 1 more ten. So it is 2 tens and 4 ones. That is 24.

items.q: Which is another way to show 25?
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 2 tens and 5 ones becomes 1 ten and 15 ones. It is still 25.

items.q: Which is another way to show 34?
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 3 tens and 4 ones becomes 2 tens and 14 ones. It is still 34.

items.q: Aaliyah has 2 bundles of 10 sticks. She has 4 loose sticks. How many sticks does she have?
items.e: 2 bundles of 10 is 2 tens, or 20. 4 loose sticks is 4 ones. 20 and 4 is 24.

items.q: Mia has 3 bundles of 10 sticks. She has 7 loose sticks. How many sticks does she have?

items.q: Lucia has 4 bundles of 10 sticks. She has 5 loose sticks. How many sticks does she have?
items.e: 4 bundles of 10 is 4 tens, or 40. 5 loose sticks is 5 ones. 40 and 5 is 45.

items.q: Each carton has 10 eggs. Gabriel has 8 full cartons. How many eggs does he have?
